evidence: Carries the Mempool label and edits src/txmempool.cpp to prevent FeeFrac integer overflows during cluster mempool linearization.
rationale: Clamping transaction fee deltas resolves a signed integer overflow in FeeFrac during cluster mempool linearization. The PR description notes a reproducible UBSan failure ("feefrac.h:108:13: runtime error: signed integer overflow") and cluster calculation corruption, which is an important correctness fix for cluster mempool data structures.
